Badge.note: the admin nav 'Requests · 2' count and the triage kickers are plain mono-coloured text, never a filled/pill container — no true Badge shape observed. Do not invent a pill; when Badge is needed elsewhere, default to bare coloured mono text first, per this direction's restraint (nothing crosses a panel edge, no decorative chrome).

default.note: the ONLY sanctioned curve in the entire system (README §Shape law). webapp: heart__avatar, object-position 50% 22%, size clamp(140px,14vw,200px). admin: 36px (h-9 w-9) initial-letter avatar, bg-secondary-500 (gold), text ink, font-mono bold.
used between ledger rows (webapp offerings) and between page sections in the admin footer — always a single hairline, never a filled divider block.

default.shimmer: none — flat static blocks, no shimmer animation
default.note: 'The panel keeps its shape and stays at rest until the values arrive. Nothing pulses.' Sized to match the real layout: a 15px label bar, a 30px value bar (at 0.22 opacity, one shade lighter to read as the emphasised line), and two 13px body bars.

default.heading: 22px semibold, ink
default.illustration: none — no illustration/graphic observed; the empty state is text + one action only, consistent with this direction's photograph-carries-the-mood rule (illustration budget is spent on the plate, not inside the pool)

default.color: accent-500 on pool (ink context) / secondary-500 (gold) on plate/dark context

marketing_masthead.context: webapp home.html — hero only, not persistent across scroll
marketing_masthead.position: absolute, overlays the hero plate (inset: 0 0 auto 0)
marketing_masthead.background: none — sits directly on the dimmed photograph, no bar/backdrop-blur
marketing_masthead.linkShape: underlined text links, NOT pill buttons — border-bottom 1px rgba(blush,0.34)
marketing_masthead.note: 5 links (What happens / The hour / What this is not / Dates & prices / Ask for an hour) — the last is a same-styled anchor into the CTA section, not a visually distinct button

admin_sidebar_rail.position: relative, in normal flex flow (flex min-h-screen), full column height
admin_sidebar_rail.background: transparent — shows the page ground (near-black), no distinct panel fill or border
admin_sidebar_rail.structure: brand lockup (full-width logo) -> 'Admin' gold mono eyebrow -> 11 nav-item rows -> mt-auto signed-in-as footer text
admin_sidebar_rail.itemHover: background gold at 8% opacity, text -> text-primary
admin_sidebar_rail.itemCurrent: INVERTS to the pool fill — background surface-inverted (blush), text-inverted (ink), font-bold. The active nav row becomes a small pool itself.
admin_sidebar_rail.countBadge: bare gold mono number pushed right via ml-auto — no pill/background, matches Badge.default (unobserved-as-pill)
admin_sidebar_rail.icons: 24x24 viewBox, stroke-width 1.6, stroke=currentColor, phosphor-equivalent line icons

Logo.markShape: organic gradient-masked silhouette (a leaf/flame form), NOT a simple geometric square or circle — do not simplify to a generic glyph
Logo.markColor: linear gradient, gold -> coral -> magenta (#F6D9A0 -> #F3C078 -> #F59A73 -> #F0707F -> #E44A8E -> #C2187A), matches the plate-to-pool warmth arc of the whole direction

wordmark.line2: WORK — magenta/accent (#D6338A, close to accent-400/500), very wide tracking (letter-spacing 52 on the primary lockup, 12 on the compact mark lockup)

default.structure: full-bleed photographic behind, one hard-edged Card/pool anchored to one edge (left on this hero), masthead overlay on top
default.plateFilter: brightness(0.52) saturate(1.14) contrast(1.05) — the plate is always dimmed at source via filter, never via a scrim overlay div
default.motion: one 24s ease-in-out alternate scale drift (1.045 -> 1.1) on the hero plate ONLY, nowhere else on the page; fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

shapeLaw: Zero border-radius everywhere except Avatar (--radius-full, true circle) and pill-shaped nothing else — no rounded-md, no rounded-lg, no rounded-full on buttons/cards/inputs. Zero box-shadow everywhere (all --shadow-* tokens resolve to 'none'); the hard cut edge of the pool against the plate/ground is the only elevation cue this direction uses. Any generated primitive shape that introduces a radius or shadow beyond this law is a misread of the mockups.
